mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals a tight labor market that may trigger monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 3-month moving average) and retail sales (RSAFS > 3-month moving average) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0), elevated federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 2000.0) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 2000.0

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signals a slowdown in economic supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicate a tight labor market that may trigger monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 4.5%
